objective: Rebuild the public AXIGNAL landing around the B2G Public Procurement Intelligence wedge without weakening source-admission or commercial-state boundaries.
outcome: A production-buildable six-locale landing explains the procurement workflow, visualises source states honestly, captures qualified Design Partner requests safely and emits no unsupported coverage, customer or performance claims.

skills.activation_reason: Keep the B2G wedge inside AXIGNAL-GOAL-001.
Resolve landing, epistemic, privacy and commercial contracts.
Register material runtime and public-claim scope before implementation.
Prevent implementation evidence from self-approving product or source gates.
Enforce AXIGNAL, axignal.com and canonical identifiers.
Review public intake abuse, validation and secret boundaries.
Minimise lead data and prevent PII analytics.
Define non-sensitive funnel and intake diagnostics.
Build SSR-first localized routes and deferred product demonstrations.
Implement bounded named motion timelines with reduced-motion parity.
Enforce texture tiers, adaptive Canvas resolution, regional Europe LOD, asset rights and measurable R3F sharpness without changing the GSAP narrative.
Replace procedural geography with attributable Earth imagery and semantic states.
Keep map colour, state and density encodings meaningful.
Preserve coherent investigation state across the scroll narrative.
Provide WCAG 2.2 AA structure and non-WebGL equivalents.
Protect LCP, INP, CLS and low-capability fallback budgets.
Implement a consent-aware no-PII event adapter.
Label packaging, prices and impact calculations as candidates.
Project the bounded TED private-pilot admission without rewriting historical technical-probe evidence or admitting discovery systems.
Provide equivalent English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German and Italian routes.
Produce unit, route, browser, accessibility and visual evidence.

external: NASA Blue Marble source and current media-use guidance
Independent visual and gate review after implementation

allowed_scope: landing tests, CI and validation scripts
landing, roadmap, ADR, task and evidence documentation
local derivatives of approved geographic and owned brand assets
prohibited_scope: Presenting TED beyond the bounded private authenticated pilot profile or admitting discovery systems
Enabling public trial activation, automatic conversion, billing, trading or personally suitable recommendations
Declaring the task or phase independently accepted

acceptance_evidence.description: Unit tests for source states, intake validation and impact calculation
Six-locale Playwright route and interaction contract
Globe source, derivative hash and attribution record
Negative intake abuse and no-PII analytics review
Architecture, motion, SEO, analytics, rollback and known-limitations report

metrics: consented CTA funnel by locale and origin
intake accepted, rejected, rate-limited and delivery-failed counts
Globe texture tier, regional LOD state, effective DPR, frame time and estimated texture memory
logs: redacted intake outcome with submission identifier and reason code
traces: intake request to configured persistence boundary without payload capture

rollback.strategy: Revert AX-F2-T18 files and restore the previous landing bundle; no database or product-source state migration is introduced.
rollback.kill_switch: Disable or roll back the landing deployment while leaving the incumbent private intake configuration unchanged.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The page sells evidence-governed opportunity investigation, not a generic tender list.
Claims, evidence, contradictions, unknowns and source states remain separate.
Navigator, Globe, dossier and evidence rail share one demonstrated InvestigationContext.
Buyer intent and synthetic fit never become admitted economic evidence.
Six explicitly authorised landing locales have route and metadata parity.
The public narrative foregrounds traceability and deterministic admission.
Prices, demo data, trial and source availability are labelled with their real state.
Intake data is purpose-limited; analytics allowlists exclude lead fields.
The change is stateless and can be rolled back as one landing deployment.
Automated and visual evidence directly tests the landing objective without advancing source gates.
